title: The pilgrim's Hajj
description: This guide's user scenarios told as one pilgrim's story, moment by moment along the overview of key process flows (steps 1–5 and A–B): Kamal, 61, from Kuala Terengganu, performs Hajj for the first time. Each moment (P0 to P7) is a sub-journey: who takes part, what happens, what in this guide specifies it, what it does not yet specify, and the policy question it raises. The setting follows the guide's Malaysian reference implementation. Every person is fictional. Told in prose on the guide's page input/pagecontent/pilgrim-journey.md.
where: Malaysia and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
